system.description:
Size Small • Speed 30ft • Darkvision 60ft • +2 Dex / +1 Con, −1 Wis

Traits

  • Mob Tactics: a creature with two or more of your allies adjacent to it can't make Attacks of Opportunity against you, and you can move through its space. Once per day, bonus damage = character level when damaging a larger creature (1 Luck for extra use).
  • Choose one skill at creation; you have Advantage on checks with it. This is not a Proficiency tier and is not one of your 3 starting skills.
  • Weapon training: shortsword, shortbow, sling, dagger.
  • Armour training: light.
